title: Riftline (GEMSDOE3) — GEMS Submission Research
description: Riftline is a separate DOE GEMS Prize fault-mapping research and submission workspace. It preserves a pinned snapshot of GEMSDOE under legacy/ while its active pipeline trains a distance-aware model using geophysical bands and multiscale context. Its docs/ site offers a direct locally validated GeoTIFF/ZIP, a browser-side file builder, a step-by-step executive submission guide, experiments, research and a dated source-health feed. Its submission manifest explicitly says that this candidate has not been uploaded or competition-scored; leaderboard figures on the site are separately identified as public snapshots rather than this candidate’s result.
